OS external-network denial/private network setup permission
independent process isolation and termination observation
no automatic retries or actual A15 use

ROWS.ENFORCER: Trusted accounting plus OS containment/independently verified closed role/descendant bound
ROWS.INDEPENDENT_EVIDENCE_REQUIRED: Observe entire authorised process tree, reserve before launch and fail at cap

ROWS.ENFORCER: Single immutable campaign admission ledger and trusted supervisor
ROWS.INDEPENDENT_EVIDENCE_REQUIRED: Audit all direct/indirect launches across seeds; no counter reset

ROWS.ENFORCER: Monotonic supervisor deadline and owned process termination
ROWS.INDEPENDENT_EVIDENCE_REQUIRED: Verify independent timeout/exit handling under separately approved metadata qualification

ROWS.ENFORCER: Kernel RLIMIT_AS or qualified stronger equivalent

ROWS.ENFORCER: Kernel RLIMIT_FSIZE or qualified stronger equivalent
ROWS.INDEPENDENT_EVIDENCE_REQUIRED: Exact child bound and allowed output namespace

ROWS.ENFORCER: Kernel RLIMIT_NOFILE and descriptor inheritance control
ROWS.INDEPENDENT_EVIDENCE_REQUIRED: Verify hard/soft caps and close unapproved inherited FDs

ROWS.INDEPENDENT_EVIDENCE_REQUIRED: Include evidence and staged/publication writes; final directory size alone is insufficient
